First release of Archangel Client, a legit PvP and cosmetics client for **Minecraft 1.21.11** (Fabric).

### Install
1. Install Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer for Minecraft 1.21.11 with the [Fabric installer](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/).
2. Put these two jars in `.minecraft/mods`:
   - `archangel-client-0.1.0.jar` (below)
   - [Fabric API 0.141.6+1.21.11](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/0.141.6+1.21.11). It must be the `+1.21.11` build.
3. Launch the fabric-loader-1.21.11 profile. Java 21 or newer.

Sodium and Iris are optional (use their 1.21.11 builds).

### What's in it
Custom menus and settings, a movable HUD with target HUD, animations, cosmetics (wings, halos, capes, auras, trails, hit effects) and a Locker, an emote wheel, nametag badges, post effects and a nebula sky, an Iris shader pack page, and an FPS boost mode. No cheats: everything is cosmetic, UI or performance.

### Notes
- Art is placeholder for now.
- Seeing other players' cosmetics and emotes needs the Archangel backend, which isn't hosted yet. Everything else works offline.
